messages:
jamie: heads-up — we need a quick decision on the new inflight "minicast" capture feature. ops wants a safe default that devs can turn on in canaries but ops shouldn't have to babysit every flip.
lia: +1. proposal: minicast = short prefix capture for 1% of requests by default, tenant-hash bucketing, automatic expiry of captures after 24h. default scrub = strict.
sanjay: worried about PII leakage in prefixes. can we define scrub profiles per route? some routes can keep metadata only, others can keep full prompt but with token-level redaction.
maria: for product teams we need observability — expose capture-rate, token-cost, and last-unredacted-sample timestamp in the console. also surface estimated $$ impact before enable.
jamie: agree on the UX bits. ops: how do quotas work? if a tenant bursts above quota, do we backpressure capture or drop oldest captures?
ops-bot: deploy-note: minicast rollout v1 -> canary 10% of hosts. telemetry hook: capture.enabled=true labels emitted.
lia: suggestion: quota model = daily capture tokens per tenant + ephemeral burst tokens. when exhausted, capture goes into 'stateless-sampling' fallback (very low prob) and we record reason in trace.
sanjay: also require an audited breakglass flow for legal/analytics — unredact requests only via 2-person-approval and short TTL. add KMS wrap for any unredacted export.
maria: console mock: add a per-tenant toggle, slider for max daily captures, and an 'impact preview' that simulates cost for last 10k reqs. link: https://go/reports/minicast-ux-proto 
jamie: curious about routing: should captured payloads route to a dedicated scrubber pool (preferred) or to existing warm storage? scrubber pool gives faster redaction but is extra infra. thoughts?
lia: scrubber pool seems safer. model: route captured items to scrubbers with strong CPU limits + async redaction. store only redacted artifacts in long-term storage; keep ephemeral pre-scrub for 1h encrypted.
sanjay: require scrub profiles as code. something like:
```
profiles:
  strict:
    mask_types: [email, phone, ssn]
    keep_tokens: 0
  relaxed:
    mask_types: [ssn]
    keep_tokens: 128
```
teams pick profile per route. default = strict.
maria: add audit logs to console: who viewed an unredacted capture, reason, and retention TTL. show a heatmap of capture density by route.
jamie: ops concern: cost control guardrails — automatic disable if projected monthly spend > X% of tenant bill or > $Y absolute. also require feature-flagged rollout and telemetry for regression detection.
ops-bot: Note: canary started on hosts (canary-42). metrics stream: minicast.capture.count=0 -> warn if > expected.
lia: next actions: write an RFC for quotas + scrub profiles, update console mock, and add runbook for breakglass. I'll draft the RFC.
sanjay: I'll sketch the scrub-profile schema and a linter to prevent wide-open profiles.
maria: I'll wire up a mock dashboard and the cost preview.
jamie: great. timeline? lia: RFC by EOD Thursday, mock by next Tue, ops runbook by next Fri. :thumbsup:
jamie: thanks — filing followups in the doc thread: https://go/r/minicast-policy
